purpose: Establish exact named native TAP positive/negative results before any D1 wrapper experiment.
positive_requires: exact individual ok result for e1-native-positive
negative_requires: exact individual not ok result for e1-native-negative
capture: Direct native CLI via shell redirects to distinct raw stdout/stderr files; original command exit retained by tool result. No D1 recorder/preload/reporter or name filters.
stop_policy: Stop immediately at first missing mandatory native result/incorrect exit. Do not execute later controls after failure. Do not rerun unchanged controls.
